about: #326: landmark instructions on the Paris film (video_moments_paris.json), labelled by card from each card's three key frames before any version ran; the film's shots run 20-40 s, so a card is one picture and its seconds are the label's. On: the Eiffel Tower close or as the subject (day 651-696 and 1001-1030, dusk and night 861-927 and 1030-1100), Versailles from the air (252-385), Notre-Dame (439-466), Sacré-Cœur (538-599), the Arc de Triomphe down an avenue (822-861), the Louvre pyramid (599-616) and the Concorde fountains (616-651). Not on, on purpose: a miniature Arc de Triomphe in a park (385-402) and the Paris Las Vegas hotel's Eiffel Tower (800-822), both copies; the tower tiny on the skyline (0-6, 186-214, 945-982); Sacré-Cœur small on its hill from the air (69-108); the Seine's bridges and the Conciergerie (466-538) and the Tuileries wheel (402-439), landmarks only loosely. 大本钟 is not in the film.
